Blocked by: REQUIRED — list prerequisite issue numbers, or write none and explain why this task is independent.

Accountable owner: one confirmed member account

Reviewer: a different teammate

## Problem and desired behavior

Describe the current behavior and intended result.

## Scope

List relevant files, interfaces and constraints. Keep the task independently reviewable.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] State observable completion criteria.
- [ ] State relevant expected and invalid-input checks, or documentation/experiment verification.
- [ ] State required outputs, traces and reproduction commands.

## Start gate

Implementation starts only after EVERY prerequisite issue is CLOSED and its required deliverable is on main. Compare this list with roadmap #27. Record prerequisite state and merged-PR/commit evidence before starting. See [collaboration guide](https://github.com/qikhcysa/dase7508-agent-privacy-boundaries/blob/main/docs/COLLABORATION.md).

## Closure

Use a linked PR, actual verification and independent teammate review. Close only after the full deliverable is merged and verified on main. Report AI assistance and each contributor's actual work.
